coldStart.title: Waking up the server…
coldStart.body: The free server sleeps when nobody is using it. This takes a few seconds the first time.

consent.title: This is first-aid help, not a doctor
consent.subtitle: We will walk you through what to do, one step at a time.
consent.emergencyBody: Do not wait on this app if they are unconscious or not breathing.
consent.disclaimerBody: Clear steps you can do now. If you are unsure, call a doctor.
consent.sourcesBody: Steps are based on these organisations — not random internet advice.

landing.title: What happened?
landing.subtitle: Choose what is closest to the situation.
landing.noResults: No match. Use “Other problem” to describe it yourself.
landing.disclaimerShort: First-aid guidance only. Call 112 or 108 in a life-threatening emergency.

patient.title: How old is the injured person?
patient.subtitle: First-aid steps change with age — CPR, choking help, and medicine doses are different for babies, children, and the elderly.

assess.imageBody: A photo can help assess the injury. It is analysed and never saved.
assess.imageTooLarge: That photo is larger than 3 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
assess.imageWrongType: Please choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.

describe.title: Describe what happened
describe.subtitle: Type or speak in English or Hindi. A few words are enough.
describe.placeholder: For example: my brother burnt his hand on hot oil, blisters have formed
describe.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. Please type instead.
describe.voiceError: Could not hear that. Please try again or type instead.

analyzing.title: Working out what to do
analyzing.subtitle: Preparing the right first-aid steps from what you told us.
analyzing.checkingDetail: Reading the symptoms and answers you shared
analyzing.consultingDetail: Matching first-aid steps to this situation
analyzing.verifyingDetail: Checking for actions that could make things worse
analyzing.generatingDetail: Putting the steps in a clear order
analyzing.reassure: You are doing the right thing by getting help.
analyzing.reassureStay: Stay nearby. The steps will appear on their own.

result.urgentBanner: See a doctor as soon as possible
result.nonUrgentBanner: You can manage this with first aid
result.actionsSubtitle: Perform these critical initial steps immediately
result.doNotSubtitle: Harmful actions that can make the injury worse
result.monitorSubtitle: Red flags that need prompt clinical review
result.followUpNotRequired: No doctor visit needed unless things change.
result.emergencyFooter: First-aid guidance only. In life-threatening emergencies, call immediately:
result.degradedBody: AI guidance is unavailable right now, so these are the standard first-aid steps for this situation.
result.rulesBody: Your answers show signs of a life-threatening emergency, so these verified steps were shown immediately.
result.notFound: This result is no longer available. Sessions are deleted after 24 hours.
result.disclaimer: General first-aid guidance. It does not replace examination by a doctor.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Something in that request was not valid. Please try again.
errors.SESSION_INVALID: Your session expired. Starting a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.IMAGE_REJECTED: That photo could not be used. Try a different one, or continue without it.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
